content.title: Yellowstone Hotels, Cabins & Lodging - Visit Yellowstone
content.text: PLAN YOUR YELLOWSTONE ADVENTURE INTO THE WILDFor more than 150 years, Yellowstone has set the standard for America’s national parks. Welcome to an extraordinary place where majestic waterfalls and ancient geysers co-exist with thriving wildlife, including grizzly bears, elk, moose and bison. We invite you to explore one of our many Yellowstone area lodging options, including Explorer Cabins, hotels and suites. Step into the wild. PLANNING? WE’VE GOT AN ITINERARY FOR YOUThere’s a lot to do when visiting Yellowstone. Take the guesswork out of planning with our highly curated itineraries! Whether you have just one day to experience the park’s highlights, a 3-day weekend to dive deeper, or are seeking a magical winter escape, we have the perfect itinerary for you. Plan Your Itinerary YELLOWSTONE NATIONAL PARK LODGING Yellowstone Vacations offers a variety of lodging options perfectly located just minutes away from the park’s West and North Entrances. YELLOWSTONE TOURS & RENTALS Explore the very best of the park with Yellowstone Vacation Tours, which offers exclusive year-round tours and activities. Let us help you design your custom Yellowstone experience. YELLOWSTONE DINING Visit the Branch Restaurant and Bar for delicious local fare and regional microbrews, or The Yellowstone Mine Restaurant for classic American fare in an “Old West” setting. BEYOND THE BOUNDARIES Yellowstone National Park is only the beginning. Learn about the many sights and adventures happening outside the park and within the surrounding communities. SERVICE UPDATES LODGING & ROAD STATUSSpring plowing has begun and most roads are closed to all vehicles until mid-April. Weather permitting, roads will begin opening for wheeled vehicle travel on April 17. The road between the North and Northeast entrances is open year-round to regular vehicles. Please visit the National Park Service website for details. West Yellowstone, MT: The Holiday Inn® West Yellowstone, Branch Restaurant and Bar, Explorer Cabins at Yellowstone, and Yellowstone Park Hotel are open. Gray Wolf Inn & Suites is temporarily closed, re-opening May 22, 2026. Gardiner, MT: The Ridgeline Hotel® at Yellowstone, Jim Bridger Explorer Cabins, Yellowstone Mine Restaurant, and Rusty Rail Lounge are open. DISCOVER YELLOWSTONE DISCOVER YELLOWSTONEExperience the majesty of Yellowstone with 2.2 million acres of mesmerizing geothermal features representing half of the world’s active geysers. Explore bubbling mud pots, clear mountain streams, fragrant evergreens and native wildlife. America’s largest national park truly has something for everyone.
